Meaning: Representative visual equivalence review, separate from byte-identical raster output and all performance rows. Not physical screen-reader certification or migration approval.

Reviewed.Originals: First viewport, whole selection and distant selected content for list/table/paragraphs/quote/details/mixed in all three appearances.
Reviewed.Targets: Rich/code, original nested lists, genuine three-level numbering, wrapping/aligned and spanning/nested-block tables, collapsed details and Unicode/bidi in all appearances.
Reviewed.Boundaries: Selected cells after distant scrolling and native media plus command buttons; exact background pixels unchanged.
Reviewed.SourceBinding: Every one of the 336 actual images per current host is pixel-identical to its 9fab9cc counterpart; current boundary pairs were also inspected directly. All 42 logical/style/geometry subsets pass per host.

Classifications.TextEdges: Minor text-edge/antialiasing differences remain; typography, wrapping, logical/style assertions, measured positions and selection geometry agree. No global raster tolerance.
Classifications.BordersMarkersDetailsMedia: Reviewed borders, clipping, markers, cell alignment, details chrome, images/diagrams and selected washes have no demonstrated material defect.
Classifications.KnownNativeChromeDifference: The first HC rich reference keeps normal scrollbar chrome although native/WPF HC state is true. Candidate uses the official public Classic HC scrollbar, as later stock references do. Exact scrollbar template identity is not claimed; this explicit native-chrome variant needs product review before migration.
Classifications.ByteIdentical: 6 of 144 paired comparison images per host are pixel-identical. Visual equivalence is not a byte-identical-rendering claim.
